summary: Ping An Biomedical Co., Ltd. (formerly Majestic Ideal Holdings) filed a routine Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the six months ended March 31, 2026, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's semi-annual report. The filing discloses segment, customer and supplier concentration data, equity compensation and IPO-related share issuances, but no transaction, offer, board recommendation or advisor. With no proposed deal, stake, price per share, premium or closing timetable stated, the report carries no special-situation or risk-arbitrage angle; monitor only for future strategic disclosures.
